tldr: Mercury in the 10th house: your mind and communication focus on career, status, and public role
body: Mercury in the 10th house: your mind and communication focus on career, status, and public role. Gift: sharp thinking there. Watch: overthinking it. With Mercury in the 10th house, thinking, speech, learning, writing, business, and the way the mind makes connections move through career, public role, reputation, authority, and legacy. This makes how you become visible, take responsibility, and build a life that can be recognized a central part of the life. Used consciously, this placement can become language, strategy, adaptability, problem-solving, and the ability to name what is happening. Left unconscious, it can become overthinking, nervous loops, clever avoidance, or talking around the feeling instead of entering it.
gift: language, strategy, adaptability, problem-solving, and the ability to name what is happening expressed through public contribution.
challenge: overthinking, nervous loops, clever avoidance, or talking around the feeling instead of entering it concentrated in public contribution.
note: Merged with approved project planet-through-house material; source file was not copied into the repository.
